_meta.description: Duelist subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: parry/counter, agile fencing, finisher precision.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la chance de parade de 0.8% et la réduction de dégâts de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases parry chance by 0.8% and damage reduction by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse d'attaque de 0.8% et l'esquive de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases attack speed by 0.8% and evasion by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la pénétration d'armure de 0.8% et les dégâts critiques de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor penetration by 0.8% and crit damage by 0.5% per level.
